process.heading: From the first call to the finished work

steps.title: Call or send a note
steps.text: Phone (760) 227-5499 or use the quote form. Tell us your name and how to reach you.

steps.title: Describe the project
steps.text: Share whether you need electrical work, a remodel, or both, and where the property is.

steps.title: Pick a weekday time
steps.text: We schedule visits Monday through Friday between 8:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m.

steps.title: Complete the agreed work
steps.text: We do the electrical or construction work we discussed, with safety in mind on every job.

safety.heading: Safety on electrical work
safety.text: Safety is not a matter we take lightly. Electrical repairs, panels, circuits, and lighting are handled by a licensed contractor, CSLB #352894.

items.a: Yes. MB Construction and Electric is licensed and insured. The published California contractor license number is CSLB #352894.

items.a: Electrical work such as wiring, panels, lighting, ceiling fans, generators, EV chargers, and low-voltage wiring, plus construction work such as renovations, kitchens, bathrooms, room and garage additions, ADUs, and design-build projects.

items.a: Call (760) 227-5499 or send the form on this site. Thank you for contacting us. We will get back to you as soon as possible.

residential-electrical-services.benefits_heading: Residential electrical work we already list

faq.q: Can you look at a panel or a circuit that is acting up?
faq.a: Yes. Panel changes, service upgrades, breaker and fuse replacement, and circuit repair are part of our residential electrical work.

faq.q: Do you install ceiling fans and lighting?
faq.a: Yes. Ceiling fan installation and energy-efficient lighting installation are listed residential services.

faq.a: Our own page says DIY wiring can put a home and family at risk. We install and repair electrical systems as a licensed contractor, CSLB #352894.
